stops.note: surname meaning 'judge'; the Budapest journalist László Bíró patented a ballpoint pen in 1938 with his brother György, using quick-drying newspaper ink
Bíró fled to Argentina and relaunched the pen in 1943; Argentines still call a ballpoint birome, from Bíró plus his partner Juan Jorge Meyne
the RAF bought the pens because they didn't leak at altitude; in the 1950s Marcel Bich bought the patent rights and launched the Bic
